name: scene_ladder
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: narrative beat 1, landscape 16:9 highest available resolution ideally 3840x2160. Inside the flooded base of the same broken medieval stone belfry, dramatic low-angle view up a kelp-slick iron ladder fixed to the right stone wall, rising diagonally from lower right toward upper centre and a high amber-lit opening. Wet iron rungs, broad strands of seaweed, cold seawater below reflecting the moon through a broken arch on left. Wren, a small agile adult bell-thief in a weathered soot-coloured hooded coat with a short muted vermilion scarf and simple leather satchel, climbs halfway up, seen from behind. One small warm candle in a brass lantern attached to Wren's belt lights hand and wet rungs. Immense height and precarious climb, not action spectacle. Left third dark water and stone, suitable for overlay. No writing or symbols.
